references.text: Job acknowledges God's sovereignty and does not question God's actions toward him, unlike the demons who challenge Jesus' authority.
The people of Israel sacrificed to demons and not to God, showing an early understanding of evil spirits as opponents to God's will.
A demon recognizes Jesus as the Son of God and asks if He has come to torment them before the appointed time, reflecting the demons' recognition in Matthew 8:29.
Demons recognize Jesus as the Son of God and beg not to be tormented, showing a parallel to the demons' fear of premature punishment in Matthew 8:29.
An evil spirit challenges the seven sons of Sceva by recognizing Jesus and Paul but not them, demonstrating the demons' ability to discern spiritual authority.
